title: Here’s a gift link to the WSJ article about Elon Musk’s “legion”...
content: Here’s a gift link to the WSJ article about Elon Musk’s “legion” of children that he’s had with his “harem” of women. “To reach legion-level before the apocalypse, we will need to use surrogates.” It’s all just so weird, gross, & white supremacist.
author: Jason Kottke
